notes: s008 `קְרֵבִים` heads on *nigh* under rule 31/44's subtraction test; *draw* was the competing head and was rejected because *draw* alone draws anything.

`וְאַל` twice fuses into one word — *nor* and *neither* — each carrying both the coordination and the negation, headed on the negative (rule 35); `מִפְּנֵי` → *at* fuses under rule 30, headed on the construct noun.
The article of `הַיּוֹם` takes the demonstrative *this* written where the phrase's *the* would stand (rule 41).
